source_value.trigger: The "Lock Options" row under Bitwarden's "SECURITY" heading, right-hand value "Immediately", is activated inside the phone mockup and the iOS action sheet headed "Lock Options" slides up from the bottom edge of the screen (media/motion.mp4 101.30s to 101.57s).
source_value.start_state: Bitwarden "Settings" with no overlay: "AUTO-FILL" (Password AutoFill, App Extension), "MANAGE" (Folders, Sync 5/1/2020 11:26 AM), "SECURITY" (Lock Options — Immediately, Unlock with Face ID — Enabled, Unlock with PIN Code — Disabled, Lock Now, Two-step Login) and "ACCOUNT" (Change Master Password, Fingerprint Phrase); last clean frame 101.300s.
source_value.end_state: The "Lock Options" action sheet settled at its resting height over the Settings list, "✓ Immediately" first, then "1 minute" through "Never", with a detached white "Cancel" bar below it (101.533s; the retained media/state-03.png is this state at 102.0s).
source_value.continuity: The asset is a cut-edited tutorial reel — the right-hand caption panel hard-cuts from "Unlock with Face ID" to "Verify Face ID" between 97.00s and 97.25s while the left-hand phone mockup keeps running. Inside the mockup the one real product transition is unbroken: consecutive 30 fps frames at 101.300s, 101.333s, 101.400s, 101.467s and 101.533s show the sheet climbing from the bottom edge to its resting height with the Settings rows still visible behind it, with no cut. Transcoding to H.264 changed encoding only; no frames were synthesized.
source_value.interruption_or_reversal: The same sheet is dismissed with no choice taken: it is still fully open at 103.967s, slides back down through 104.033s, 104.100s and 104.167s, and is gone at 104.200s, and the "Lock Options" row underneath still reads "Immediately" — the value it carried before the sheet opened.
source_value.feedback: The overlay is itself the acknowledgment: it enters from the edge the finger came from, dims nothing but covers the list from the bottom up so the rows behind stay legible, and it restates the value already printed on the Settings row by putting a "✓" against "Immediately" (101.333s to 101.533s). The "Cancel" bar arrives last, separated from the option list by a gap.
